newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sydney Casino says PBL still on for deal.
newsitem.headline: Sydney Casino says PBL still on for deal.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd managing director Neil Gamble said Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd (PBL) still intended to go ahead with its planned purchase of management control at the casino.

The Ausralian newspaper reported on Wednesday that PBL is expected to announce that it has decided not to take up the option to buy 10 percent of Sydney Harbour Casino from Showboat and management control of the casino, in order to focus on a planned bid for John Fairfax Holdings Ltd.
"They have told us they are still going ahead," Sydney Casino chief executive officer Neil Gamble told Reuters.
"That article is totally inaccurate," Gamble said.

PBL, controlled by Australia's richest man Kerry Packer, announced in January it would spend A$340 million on a 10 percent in Sydney casino and 85 percent of the casino managment contract from U.S. casino operator Showboat Inc.
Brokers said the newspaper report contributed to the fall in Sydney Casino's share price earlier on Wednesday.
The stock hit a low of A$2.10, but recovered some ground to end just two cents off at A$2.16.
PBL officials were unavailable for comment.
